name: CreateWorkflowInstances

parameters.help_en:

项目环境。
Prod：生产
Dev：开发
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workflow to which the task belongs. The WorkflowId of a periodic task is always 1
parameters.help_zh: 所属工作流的ID。周期任务的WorkflowId均为1
parameters.name: workflow_id

fields.help_en: The end business date. Format: `yyyy-mm-dd`

fields.help_en: The start business date. Format: `yyyy-mm-dd`

fields.name: start_biz_date

fields.help_zh: 业务日期列表。可指定多段业务日期（最多7段）
fields.name: biz_dates

fields.help_en:
The end time of the period. Format: `hh:mm:ss` in 24-hour format. Default value: 23:59:59.

If you specify this field, you must also specify the StartTime field
fields.help_zh:
指定结束周期时间，格式为`hh:mm:ss`，24小时制，默认23:59:59。

如果填写此字段需要StartTime与EndTime需要同时填写
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en:
The start time of the period. Format: `hh:mm:ss` in 24-hour format. Default value: 00:00:00.

指定开始周期时间，格式为`hh:mm:ss`，24小时制，默认00:00:00。

如果填写此字段需要StartTime与EndTime需要同时填写

parameters.help_en:
The type of the workflow instance. Valid values:
SupplementData: data backfill. The methods for specifying RootTaskIds and IncludeTaskIds vary based on the data backfill pattern. For more information, see the parameter description of DefaultRunProperties.Mode.
ManualWorkflow: manual workflow. You must set WorkflowId to the ID of the manual workflow. RootTaskIds is optional. If you do not specify RootTaskIds, the default root node list of the manual workflow is used.
Manual: manual task. You only need to specify RootTaskIds, which is the list of manual tasks to be run.
SmokeTest: smoke test. You only need to specify RootTaskIds, which is the list of test tasks to be run.
TriggerWorkflow: trigger-based workflow. You must set WorkflowId to the ID of the trigger-based workflow. IncludeTaskIds is optional. If you do not specify IncludeTaskIds, the entire workflow is run
parameters.help_zh:
工作流实例的类型。

SupplementData：补数据。RootTaskIds与IncludeTaskIds的填写方法随补数据模式而变化，见DefaultRunProperties.Mode参数说明
ManualWorkflow：手动业务流程。WorkflowId需要填手动业务流程的WorkflowId，RootTaskIds选填，不填则会使用手动业务流程默认的根节点列表。
Manual：手动任务。仅需填RootTaskIds，即为要运行的手动任务列表。
SmokeTest：冒烟测试。仅需填RootTaskIds，即为要运行的测试任务列表。
TriggerWorkflow：触发式工作流。WorkflowId需要填触发式工作流的WorkflowId，IncludeTaskIds选填，不填则会运行整个工作流
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The workflow parameters. This parameter takes effect only when a specific workflow is specified (WorkflowId != 1). For a periodic workflow or a trigger-based workflow, the format is key=value, and the priority is lower than that of task parameters. For a manual workflow, the format is JSON, and the priority is higher than that of task parameters
parameters.help_zh: 工作流参数，当指定唯一工作流（`WorkflowId != 1`）时生效。若为周期工作流、触发式工作流，格式为key=value，优先级低于任务参数；若为手动业务流程，格式为JSON，优先级高于任务参数
parameters.name: workflow_parameters

parameters.help_en: The task parameters. You can use this parameter to set parameters for specific tasks. The value is in JSON format. The key is the task ID. For the format of the value, refer to the task script parameters (Task.Script.Parameter in the response of the GetTask operation)
parameters.help_zh: 任务参数，为特定任务设置参数。JSON格式，key为任务ID，value的格式参考任务脚本参数（GetTask接口的结果Task.Script.Parameter）
parameters.name: task_parameters

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to run the instance immediately after it is created. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 创建后是否直接运行，默认为true
parameters.name: auto_start_enabled

fields.help_en:
The notification method. Valid values:
Sms: text message only.
Mail: email only.
SmsMail: text message and email
fields.help_zh:
通知方式。
Sms：仅短信
Mail：仅邮件
SmsMail：短信加邮件
fields.name: notice_type

fields.help_en:
The alert policy. Valid values:
Success: alerts on success.
Failure: alerts on failure.
SuccessFailure: alerts on both success and failure
fields.help_zh:
报警策略。
Success 成功告警
Failure 失败告警
SuccessFailure 成功和失败都告警
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The alert configurations
fields.help_zh: 报警配置
fields.name: alert

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to block the run if the analysis fails. This parameter is required when Type is set to SupplementData
fields.help_zh: 分析不通过的情况下是否阻塞运行。Type=SupplementData时必填
fields.name: blocked

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable analysis. This parameter is required when Type is set to SupplementData
fields.help_zh: 是否开启分析。Type=SupplementData时必填
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The analysis configurations. This parameter is required when Type is set to SupplementData
fields.help_zh: 分析配置。Type=SupplementData时必填
fields.name: analysis

fields.help_en: The list of project IDs not to be run
fields.help_zh: 不需要运行的项目ID列表
fields.name: exclude_project_ids

fields.help_en: The list of task IDs not to be run
fields.help_zh: 不要运行的任务ID列表
fields.name: exclude_task_ids

fields.help_en: The list of project IDs to be run
fields.help_zh: 需要运行的项目ID列表
fields.name: include_project_ids

fields.help_en: The list of task IDs to be run
fields.help_zh: 需要运行的任务ID列表
fields.name: include_task_ids

fields.help_en:
The data backfill mode. Default value: ManualSelection. This parameter is required when Type is set to SupplementData. Valid values:
General: general mode. You can specify only one ID in RootTaskIds. IncludeTaskIds is optional. If you do not specify IncludeTaskIds, the tasks in RootTaskIds are included by default.
ManualSelection: manual selection mode. You can specify multiple IDs in RootTaskIds. IncludeTaskIds is optional. If you do not specify IncludeTaskIds, the tasks in RootTaskIds are included by default.
Chain: chain mode. RootTaskIds must be left empty. You must specify two IDs in IncludeTaskIds, which are the start and end tasks.
AllDownstream: all downstream mode. You can specify only one ID in RootTaskIds
fields.help_zh:
补数据模式，默认为ManualSelection。Type=SupplementData时必填。
General：普通模式，`RootTaskIds`仅能填一个，`IncludeTaskIds`选填，不填会默认包含`RootTaskIds`中的内容
ManualSelection：手动选择，`RootTaskIds`能填多个，`IncludeTaskIds`选填，不填会默认包含`RootTaskIds`中的内容
Chain：链路，`RootTaskIds`为空，`IncludeTaskIds`填两个id，分别是起始和结束任务
AllDownstream：所有下游，`RootTaskIds`仅能填一个
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en:
The run order. Default value: Asc. Valid values:
Asc: ascending order by business date.
Desc: descending order by business date
fields.help_zh:
运行顺序，默认为Asc。
Asc：按业务日期升序。
Desc：按业务日期降序
fields.name: order

fields.help_en: The number of parallel tasks. A value from 2 to 10 indicates the parallelism. A value of 1 indicates serial execution. This parameter is required when Type is set to SupplementData
fields.help_zh: 任务并行数。取值2~10时为并行度， 取值1时为串行。Type=SupplementData时必填
fields.name: parallelism

fields.help_en: The run priority. Valid values: 1 to 11. A larger value indicates a higher priority. These parameter settings are supported only for manual workflows and trigger-based workflows
fields.help_zh: 运行优先级，取值范围为1~11。取值越大，优先级越高。（该参数配置只支持手动业务流程与触发式工作流）
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en:
The priority weight policy. These parameter settings are supported only for manual workflows and trigger-based workflows. Valid values:
Disable: disabled. This is the default value.
Upstream: calculates the sum of the weights of the upstream nodes of the current node. A deeper hierarchy indicates a higher weight
fields.help_zh:
优先级权重策略。（该参数配置只支持手动业务流程与触发式工作流）
`Disable`：不启用（默认）
`Upstream`：当前节点计算上游的权重总和。即层次越深，权重越高
fields.name: priority_weight_strategy

fields.help_en:
The list of root task IDs.
When Type is set to SupplementData, RootTaskIds is required except when Mode is set to Chain.
When Type is set to ManualWorkflow, RootTaskIds is optional. If you do not specify RootTaskIds, the default root node list of the manual workflow is used.
When Type is set to Manual, RootTaskIds is required and specifies the list of manual tasks to be run.
When Type is set to SmokeTest, RootTaskIds is required and specifies the list of test tasks to be run
fields.help_zh:
根任务ID列表。

Type=SupplementData时。除Mode=Chain的情况外，RootTaskIds均必填。
Type=ManualWorkflow时。RootTaskIds选填，不填则会使用手动业务流程默认的根节点列表。
Type=Manual时。RootTaskIds必填，即为要运行的手动任务列表。
Type=SmokeTest时：RootTaskIds必填，即为要运行的测试任务列表
fields.name: root_task_ids

fields.help_en: The end time of the run. Format: `hh:mm:ss` in 24-hour format. This field is required if you configure a run policy
fields.help_zh: 结束运行时间，格式为`hh:mm:ss`，24小时制。若设置运行策略，此字段必填
fields.name: end_time

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the run can be started immediately if the scheduled run time is in the future. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 运行时间在未来是否可以立即运行起来，默认为false
fields.name: immediately

fields.help_en: The start time of the run. Format: `hh:mm:ss` in 24-hour format. This field is required if you configure a run policy
fields.help_zh: 开始运行时间，格式为`hh:mm:ss`，24小时制。若设置运行策略，此字段必填
fields.name: start_time

fields.help_en:
The period type. This field is required if you configure a run policy. Valid values:
Daily: every day.
Weekend: weekends only
fields.help_zh:
时段类型。若设置运行策略，此字段必填。
Daily：每天
Weekend：仅周末
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The run policy. If this field is left empty, the task configuration is used
fields.help_zh: 运行策略。该字段为空则跟随任务配置
fields.name: run_policy

fields.help_en: The identifier of the custom scheduling resource group. If this field is left empty, the task configuration is used
fields.help_zh: 自定义调度资源组标识符，该字段为空则跟随任务配置
fields.name: runtime_resource

fields.help_en: The tag key
fields.help_zh: 标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value
fields.help_zh: 标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tag creation policy.
Append: Append mode. Inherits existing tags from the manual business process and appends new tags.
Overwrite: Overwrite mode. Does not inherit existing tags from the manual business process and directly creates tags
parameters.help_zh:
标签创建策略。
Append：追加模式，在继承手动业务流程已有标签的基础上追加新的标签。
Overwrite：覆盖模式，不继承手动业务流程已有标签，直接创建标签
parameters.name: tag_creation_policy

OperationId.description_en: The operation ID. You can use this field to query the result of the creation operation by calling the GetCreateWorkflowInstancesResult API operation
OperationId.description_zh: 操作ID。您可以凭借此字段通过GetCreateWorkflowInstancesResult接口来查询创建操作的结果

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use this ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的ID，用于定位日志，排查问题
